title: Mean estimation in spatial functional data
summary: Functional mean estimation exhibits a sparse-to-dense phase transition as the number of measurements per curve increases. For spatially indexed functional data, however, dependence between nearby curves and increasing spatial sampling density fundamentally alter this transition. We investigate this phenomenon under a unified framework allowing both increasing-domain and infill asymptotics, with irregular temporal observations.
